en-US.description:
PALY Press brings every Palo Alto High School newsroom into one free reader.

Read The Paly Voice, The Campanile, Verde Magazine, InFocus, C Magazine, Viking Sports, Anthro, Ink, Veritas, Via Verde, KPLY, [proof], and more—without jumping between websites.

FEATURES
• Home feed — all publications together, or switch to a single masthead
• Local News — government, elections, campus, and community coverage across newsrooms
• Calendar — school and campus events in a dedicated tab
• Publications — browse every masthead, open staff directories, or visit each site
• Follow & alerts — notifications by publication, plus an optional Monday email digest
• Save stories — bookmark articles to read later when signed in
• In-app reader — byline, share, text size, and full stories
• Search — find stories by keyword across publications

Built by and for the Paly journalism community. Content remains © its respective publications.

Support & privacy: https://palyjournalism.com

review.notes:
PALY Press is a free news reader for Palo Alto High School student publications.

Sign-in is optional. Core browsing (Home, Local News, Calendar, Publications, article reader) works without an account. Sign-in is only needed for comments, saved articles sync, and notification preferences.

GUIDELINE 1.2 / 2.1(a) WALKTHROUGH
1. Open Profile. Before any login method, check “I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.” Tap Terms of Service to read the full EULA in-app. Then tap Sign in with Apple.
2. Open any article with comments. On another user’s comment, tap Report (choose a reason) to flag it. Tap Block to hide that author from your feed immediately; we are emailed at the same time. Profile → Blocked Users lists blocked authors.
3. We review reports within 24 hours and remove the comment / suspend the account from the admin dashboard.

No paid features. No in-app purchases.
